Limit to mniej niż 100 000 000 B bez kom: The limit is less than 100,000,000 uncompressed bytes. The separate smallest-image badge requires less than 50 MB. It adds no U points. A smaller image wins ranking ties.

To mediana najwyższych zaliczonych pozio: It is the median highest passing level across three runs. A level requires 0% errors, p99 < 500 ms, enough requests and successful integrity checks. Exact ties share a place.

Starter celowo jest wolny. Zachowaj API,: The starter is deliberately slow. Preserve the API; you can replace the language and implementation. Listen on 0.0.0.0:8080 and store SQLite in /data. This container is for local development with your own code only.
Checker zapisuje dane testowe. Sprawdza: The checker writes test data. It checks validation, feed order, Unicode, write visibility and like idempotency. The checker alone does not restart the container; the next smoke step performs the full SIGKILL and persistence check.
Najpierw pobierz przypięte narzędzia. Ru: First pull the pinned tools. The runner never downloads them automatically. Smoke runs three measurements at 2/5/10 VU, checks data after SIGKILL, writes JSON to results/ and removes its own containers. It uses 256 MiB RAM and tmpfs for /data: this is a functional check, not a competition result or host-restart durability test. If the subnet conflicts, set BENCH_SUBNET to a free range. Docker must support isolated network mode.
Sprawdź plany zapytań, liczbę odczytów S: Inspect query plans, SQLite read counts, connection and locking costs, and image layers. Change one thing at a time and repeat the checks. Preserve validation and durability; every acknowledged write must survive SIGKILL. Do not hardcode responses or benchmark data.
Obraz musi mieć mniej niż 100 000 000 B: The image must be under 100,000,000 uncompressed bytes; the target is under 50 MB, with no extra bonus. Inspect shows the field currently used by the runner. Port: nasłuchuj na 0.0.0.0 i PORT=8080,: Port: listen on 0.0.0.0 and PORT=8080, not just localhost. Data: use DATA_DIR=/data; the root filesystem is read-only and the process uses UID/GID 10001. Signals: forward SIGTERM to the server (exec in your entrypoint) and shut down cleanly. Durability: clean shutdown is not enough - acknowledged posts and likes must also survive SIGKILL. Do not rely on process memory. /health must return valid JSON within 30 seconds. Local container name conflict: stop and remove only your own vz-starter; its data volume remains.
